scripts.supabase:studio: echo 'Opening Supabase Studio at http://127.0.0.1:54323' && open http://127.0.0.1:54323 || xdg-open http://127.0.0.1:54323
scripts.env:use-local: echo 'Copying .env.development to .env.local for both apps' && cp apps/web/.env.development apps/web/.env.local && cp apps/mobile/.env.development apps/mobile/.env.local
scripts.env:use-prod: echo 'Copying .env.production to .env.local for both apps' && cp apps/web/.env.production apps/web/.env.local && cp apps/mobile/.env.production apps/mobile/.env.local
